newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Greater Asia up 5.68 pct on buy-in talks.
newsitem.headline: Greater Asia up 5.68 pct on buy-in talks.

text.p: Gaming firm Greater Asia Resources Corp rose 5.68 percent or 10 centavos to 1.86 pesos a share in mid-trade in Manila on Wednesday on rumours of a buy-in by businessman-politician Eduardo Cojuangco, brokers said.
"Rumours have it that Danding Cojuangco is buying into Greater Asia through (a) backdoor listing," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc.
According to market talk, Cojuangco a relative of former President Corazon Aquino, will beef up the company's paid-up capital to 2.5 billion pesos and focus on the cement business.
Officials of Greater Asia could not be reached for comment.
